title: Rules Template — Instruction Array Structure
applicability: Apply whenever creating, interpreting, modifying, inserting into, or validating the account custom-instruction outer array or nested instruction groups. This reference defines the wrapper's structural rules; an actual wrapper's index-zero explainer should link here rather than duplicate this document.

definitions.explainer: A potentially verbose, complete JSON object permanently located at index 0 of its own instruction array. It establishes the local applicability and interpretive context of that array.
definitions.standalone_rule: One complete JSON object with a descriptive title, occupying exactly one index after its parent array's explainer. The object's nested models, requirements, conditions, and examples remain members of the same rule.
definitions.grouped_rule: A nested instruction array that occupies one parent index and contains rules on exactly one subject. Its index-zero explainer must include a title identifying that subject.
definitions.local_interpretation: Interpretation instructions in a group explainer that govern the group and can explicitly override conflicting inherited interpretation only within that group.

requirements.title: Pinned explainer
requirements.applies_to: Every outer and inner instruction array.
requirements.required_behavior: Reserve index 0 for one complete explainer object. Keep it at index 0 throughout insertions, deletions, and reordering of later entries. Allow all descriptive members and nested structures needed to clarify interpretation.

requirements.title: One complete standalone rule per index
requirements.applies_to: Every standalone rule in any instruction array.
requirements.required_behavior: Store the complete rule in one object at one nonzero index. Require a descriptive title. Never split a verbose rule into separate entries merely because it contains multiple models, nested objects, constraints, or examples.

requirements.title: One subject per group
requirements.required_behavior: Treat each inner array as one parent entry representing a single subject. Require its index-zero explainer to contain a descriptive group title and sufficient subject, applicability, and local interpretation context.

requirements.title: Newest outer entry inserted at index 1
requirements.applies_to: Insertion of any standalone rule or grouped array into the outer array.
requirements.required_behavior: Insert immediately after the pinned explainer, at index 1. Shift all previous entries at index 1 or above forward by one without changing their contents or relative order.

requirements.title: Newest inner entry inserted at index 1
requirements.applies_to: Insertion of a subordinate rule into an existing grouped array.
requirements.required_behavior: Keep the group's explainer pinned at index 0, insert the new subordinate rule at index 1, and retain existing subordinate entries' contents and relative order.

requirements.title: Bounded local precedence
requirements.required_behavior: Apply inherited interpretations unless a group's explainer explicitly states a conflicting local interpretation. A local override governs only that group's entries and never changes sibling or enclosing arrays.

requirements.title: Preserve instruction meaning
requirements.applies_to: Any wrapper conversion, editing, or insertion.
requirements.required_behavior: Retain all substantive requirements and user-authorized scope of each rule. Adding a descriptive title does not permit altering the rule's applicability, definitions, required operations, or examples.

requirements.title: Machine-dialect authoring
requirements.applies_to: All explainers, rule objects, nested fields, and examples.
requirements.required_behavior: Write semantically complete machine-oriented instructions, not just valid JSON. Apply the separate writing requirements and examples at references/machine-dialect-rules.json.

requirements.title: External definition references
requirements.required_behavior: Provide rules_template_path pointing to references/rules-template.json and machine_dialect_rules_path pointing to references/machine-dialect-rules.json. Do not reproduce the full template requirements within the template's own explainer.

valid_outer_array.title: Standalone Scope Rule
valid_outer_array.applicability: Every operation performed on a user request.

valid_outer_array.title: Conversation Analytics
valid_outer_array.interpretation: This group governs the following conversation analytics rule.

valid_outer_array.title: Record Each Completed Turn
valid_outer_array.required_behavior: Append a completed analytics record after every completed turn when persistent storage is available.

valid_insertion.note: The strings illustrate ordering, not literal valid rule entries. Index 0 stays pinned, and prior entries preserve relative order.

invalid_examples.title: Explainer last
invalid_examples.violation: Putting the explanation at the final index contradicts the pinned index-zero rule.

invalid_examples.title: One rule split across multiple indices
invalid_examples.violation: Separating the model and examples of one verbose rule into sibling entries changes its rule boundary.

invalid_examples.title: Unrelated subjects in one group
invalid_examples.violation: An inner array containing unrelated subjects violates the single-subject requirement.

invalid_examples.title: Self-defined template
invalid_examples.violation: Copying all structural rules into a template's index-zero explainer instead of referencing the external rules template duplicates the template's governing definition.

validation: Check pinned index-zero objects, titles, complete single-index rules, one subject per group, index-one insertion, explicit local overrides, unchanged rule content, and valid external reference paths.
